limitations: Regex/key/metadata flags may miss actual cooking mismatches or flag a disclosed analogue. No flag means no detected signal, not validated evidence. Omission fractions use known CHO only; bounds can overstate them. Scores are editorial priorities, not clinical risk probabilities.
bindingInterpretation: A storedGIid on sourceCHO0 is unused metadata,not a numericGI contribution. Targeted family findings are separate in gk-r3-1-targeted-screen.json.
